## What MOFI AI Does

MOFI AI is India's leading AI automation training institute and agency that teaches and delivers automation in Telugu.

Two business lines:
1. AI AUTOMATION SERVICES — We build AI-powered systems for businesses (chatbots, voice agents, WhatsApp automation, N8N workflows, web scraping, API integrations).
2. AI TRAINING PROGRAMS — We teach N8N automation, AI agents, WhatsApp automation and workflow automation in Telugu.

## AI Automation Services

All services are available for businesses in Hyderabad, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and globally.

1. AI Chatbots & Agents — Custom AI chatbots for customer support, lead qualification, FAQ automation
2. Voice Agents & Call Automation — AI phone agents using Retell AI + N8N; handle inbound calls 24/7
3. N8N Workflow Automation — Multi-step business workflows connecting CRMs, emails, databases, APIs
4. WhatsApp Business Automation — Automated replies, order updates, booking confirmations via WhatsApp API
5. Web Scraping & Lead Generation — Google Maps scraping, B2B lead lists, automated prospecting
6. Custom API Integrations — Connect disparate business tools; custom middleware and webhook pipelines

Service enquiries: https://mofiai.com/services
